title: How AI startups and founders use "taste" as the latest buzzword for describing and distinguishing their products, in an attempt to evoke an aura of artisanality (Kyle Chayka/New Yorker)
summary: Kyle Chayka / New Yorker: How AI startups and founders use “taste” as the latest buzzword for describing and distinguishing their products, in an attempt to evoke an aura of artisanality — In the age of A.I., the term has become as much of a Silicon Valley cliché as “disruption” was in the twenty-tens.
contentText:
Kyle Chayka / New Yorker :

How AI startups and founders use “taste” as the latest buzzword for describing and distinguishing their products, in an attempt to evoke an aura of artisanality   —  In the age of A.I., the term has become as much of a Silicon Valley cliché as “disruption” was in the twenty-tens.
